NON-APPROPRIATED FUND POSITION DESCRIPTION JOB TITLE: Human Resources Technician BUSINESS TITLE: Human Resources Talent Acquisition Specialist FLSA: Non-exempt JOB SERIES: 0203 PAY LEVEL: NF-3 DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES: The primary purpose of this position is to partner with senior management in staff planning and to work closely with hiring managers to identify talent needs, as well as manage the full life cycle of the recruiting process for the entire company.

Serves as the company¿s subject matter expert on all phases of the recruiting and staffing process from strategic sourcing, screening, workforce planning, talent acquisition, interviewing, selection, in-processing and advises managers on best practices associated with on-boarding.

Advises and assists candidates on resume preparation, the submission status of applications, writing effective KSA¿s, and when appropriate, provides career counseling. Responds to inquiries, grievances and complaints based on rating of qualifications, military spouse preference and internal merit promotion actions, as appropriate.

Advises hiring managers on best practices related to behavioral based interviews, strategic sourcing, and core competency recruiting. Designs customized hiring packages for management to include competency modeling. Screens and rates applicants as per established Marine Corp Order and local directives.

Participates in local job fairs, new comer briefings, new employee orientation briefings, leadership training, as directed. Sources strategically for World Wide positions in order to deliver a robust slate of high quality candidates for immediate opening.

Looks for ways to continuously improve sourcing capabilities and networks in order to meet ongoing recruiting needs.

Performs various administrative duties including: job postings, screening candidates, presenting resumes to hiring managers, scheduling interviews and prepares selection register package for managers and in-processes selected candidate. Prepares and analyzes a variety of standard/custom reports to meet specific requirements as directed.

Processes selected candidate with completion of HR paperwork in accordance with appropriate regulatory and office guidance. Enters HR data into automated personnel systems and databases. Establishes and maintains HR files and records according to existing office procedures.

Responsible for all functions related to background investigations including stateside and local for sensitive positions involving children, youth, and teen. Submits status report to facility managers weekly. May serve as the NAF DFWP Coordinator, working as a liaison with MCCS headquarters to disseminate information within the local organization.

Ensures the accuracy of positions designated for drug testing; maintains confidentiality and security of the filing system; schedules drug tests and reports results. Provides World Class Customer Service with an emphasis on courtesy. Assists customers and communicates positively in a friendly manner. Takes action to solve problems quickly.

Alerts the higher-level supervisor, or proper point of contact for help when problems arise. Adheres to safety regulations and standards. Promptly reports any observed workplace hazards, and any injury, occupational illness, and/or property damage resulting from workplace mishaps to the immediate supervisor.

Adheres to established standards of actively supporting the principles of the EEO program and prevention of sexual harassment. Performs other related duties as assigned.
BASIC REQUIREMENTS: A minimum of three years of Human Resources or related experience. Qualification Requirements: Ability to interpret and apply rules, regulations and policies applicable to recruiting and staffing.

Demonstrated progressive Human Resources (HR) experience that includes experience with high volume recruiting and the development of talent pipelines an acquired knowledge of the theories, principles, practices and techniques of HR expertise.

Ability to analyze, problem-solve, and make decisions to implement appropriate recruiting strategies to fill vacancies. Skills in operating a personal computer, various software programs (Microsoft Word, Excel, etc.).

Demonstrated ability to work in a fast-paced environment with the ability to manage multiple tasks and changing requirements with excellent customer service skills. Ability to effectively communicate both orally and in writing to convey a wide variety of information to diverse audiences.

Experience influencing and interacting with senior management and develop rapport and a high degree of trust, representing the recruiting department at the executive level. Ability to establishing candidate development methodologies to include best practices and core competency models. This activity is a Drug-free workplace.

The use of illegal drugs by NAF employees, whether on or off duty, cannot and will not be tolerated. Federal employees have a right to a safe and secure workplace, and Marines, sailors, and their family members have a right to a reliable and productive Federal workforce.

We're looking for a passionate and driven Talent Acquisition Specialist to join our People team in Spain! This is a fully remote role, giving you the flexibility to work from anywhere in the country. Please note that candidates must currently reside in Spain.
Join us at an exciting stage of growth at Wellhub, where you'll play a key role in shaping our European expansion. As a Talent Acquisition Specialist, you will partner closely with hiring managers and senior stakeholders to attract, engage, and hire top talent across the region.
In this role, you'll translate business needs into effective hiring strategies, helping to build high-performing teams that drive success in both established and new markets. You'll take ownership of end-to-end recruitment processes, ensuring an outstanding candidate experience while maintaining speed and quality.
Beyond day-to-day hiring, you'll contribute to improving recruiting practices through data-driven insights, helping us scale efficiently as we continue to grow. This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys a mix of hands-on recruiting and strategic impact, and who is excited to help shape the future of our teams across Europe.

Manage the full-cycle recruitment process for non-technical roles up to G7 level, ensuring high-quality hires and alignment with business needs.
Partner closely with Hiring Managers and People Business Partners to define hiring strategies, evaluation criteria, and ensure a seamless calibration through kickoff meetings.
Develop and implement innovative sourcing strategies to build diverse talent pipelines and improve overall hiring effectiveness.
Drive a positive candidate experience by maintaining transparent communication, providing timely feedback, and acting as a professional brand ambassador for Wellhub.
Analyze recruitment metrics and data to identify bottlenecks, optimize processes, and formally propose improvements to increase the TA function's efficiency.
Ensure compliance with global labor laws, internal SLAs, and data accuracy (cost centers, candidate stages, and budget alignment) within our ATS (Greenhouse).
Promote diversity, equity, and belonging by proactively sourcing from underrepresented groups and mitigating biases throughout the selection process.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams (People Ops, OD&B) to ensure smooth onboarding and contribute to employer branding initiatives.
Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life wellness.

Degree in Business Administration, Human Resources, Psychology, or a related field.
Proven experience in full-cycle recruitment, with a focus on high-demand environments.
Strong analytical skills to track, interpret, and report recruitment metrics.
Demonstrated ability to match financial budgets with candidate expectations regarding salary and benefits.
Experience with Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS), preferably Greenhouse, to manage candidate pipelines.
Solid knowledge of sourcing strategies and tools to attract diverse talent.

You will join selectry as a Senior Recruiter and run end-to-end searches through our Hiring Engine for our clients. You own the process from structured intake to signed offer, use data to improve it, and build the sourcing infrastructure that makes the next search faster than the one before.
Why this role exists
selectry is a Berlin-based hr-tech company. We build and operate the Hiring Engine for plannable recruiting. Our three product lines cover different levels of recruiting ownership for our clients. What they share is a common requirement: searches need to be run well, documented clearly, and improved continuously.
We are a small, senior team. Decisions move quickly. The work is concrete. We run our own searches and source proactively rather than relying on inbound volume. We source, assess, and advise, and we document every step.
This role exists because the Hiring Engine needs an experienced recruiter who can carry searches independently, consult clients and hiring managers with evidence and clarity, and help build the sourcing and process infrastructure that makes selectry's output reliable and repeatable.
What you will work on
Own the full recruiting lifecycle across client searches, from intake and role clarification through active sourcing, structured assessment, and offer management to signed contract
Design and run multi-channel sourcing strategies using LinkedIn Recruiter, XING, and direct outreach, including complex Boolean search and talent mapping for specialist and leadership profiles
Build and maintain talent pools of passive candidates across the segments selectry searches most frequently, structured, auditable, and ready for the next search
Conduct structured, competency-based interviews and advise hiring managers on evaluation criteria, profile fit, and decision quality
Track, analyse, and report on recruiting KPIs, including time-to-hire, time-to-fill, funnel conversion, and source-of-hire, and use the data to improve the process at every stage
Create and maintain search briefs, outreach templates, and interview guides within selectry's documentation infrastructure
Lead employer branding projects for selectry itself, for example career page content, candidate experience improvements, and outreach standards
Must-haves
Strong experience in recruiting, with end-to-end ownership of complex, specialist, or leadership hiring processes from sourcing through to offer
Hands-on active sourcing experience with LinkedIn Recruiter and multi-channel direct outreach, including the ability to design Boolean search strategies and talent maps independently
Experience building and maintaining structured talent pools for passive candidate segments using a CRM or ATS
Experience conducting competency-based candidate interviews and advising hiring managers on evaluation frameworks and profile decisions
KPI literacy: you have tracked recruiting data and used it to change a process, with a concrete example you can explain
German at C2 level and English at minimum C1, both required from day one, as searches run in both languages
Reliable self-management in a remote setup, careful documentation, and clear written communication
Nice-to-haves
Background in sales recruiting, executive search, or specialist/leadership hiring in a B2B or technology environment
Delivered employer branding work with concrete outputs, for example employer value proposition (EVP) development, career page content, candidate experience design, or career fair coordination
Familiarity with mid-market ATS or CRM-based recruiting platforms, for example Personio, Greenhouse, or Recruitee
Familiarity with the DACH talent market and its sourcing dynamics, particularly for niche or hard-to-fill profiles
How we work
selectry is fully remote within Germany, with our registered office in Berlin. The team is deliberately small so decisions are made quickly and work stays concrete. We use documented playbooks, clean process logic, and a tooling setup.
Technology supports the work. Humans verify and decide. That applies to how we run our product and to how we work internally.
There are no vanity metrics here. A good search is one where the right person was found, the process was fair, and the documentation lets us learn from it.
Working conditions
Location: 100% remote (DE), registered office in Berlin
Work model: Full-time, flexible hours with agreed collaboration windows
Contract: Permanent employment
Languages: German C2 (mandatory), English min. C1 (mandatory)

About A1 There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks that are not AI-native. Our mission is to build a proactive smart assistant for everyday users to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal prompting.

Our product focuses on achieving high reliability for long-running workflows, persistent context, and real-world task completion. The system must handle multi-step reasoning, interact with external tools, and remain reliable despite non-deterministic model behavior.

Our objective is to help users complete tasks daily enjoyable with over ~90%* reduced time. About the Role You will lead hiring across software engineering functions including backend, mobile, desktop, infrastructure, and product engineering.

You will partner closely with founding teams, leadership and engineering leaders to identify and attract high-caliber talent globally. This role requires strong judgment, speed, sourcing ability, and deep understanding of engineering talent quality beyond resumes and brand names. What You'll Be Doing
Own end-to-end hiring across assigned roles - from intake to close
Build pipelines from scratch using direct sourcing, referrals, and targeted outreach
Drive hiring decisions with clear signals, not just interview feedback
Keep processes moving - remove delays, chase feedback, close candidates
Redesign interview questions, scorecards, and assessments to raise hiring bar
Recruitment processes - improve speed, quality, and consistency across hiring
Build employer presence through content, messaging, and candidate experience
What You'll Need
Proven experience in recruiting / talent acquisition (in-house or agency)
Proven track record of closing roles in a fast-paced environment
Strong sourcing ability - able to generate pipelines without relying on inbound
Good judgment - able to identify strong candidates beyond resumes
Ability to manage multiple roles with speed and consistency
Willingness to challenge and improve existing processes
Clear, direct communication with hiring managers and candidates
Comfortable operating with ambiguity and high expectations
How We Work The best products in the world are built by small, highly capable teams. We operate with high talent density, fast execution speed, and strong ownership. We care deeply about product quality, clear thinking, and practical execution. This is a hands-on environment.

Everyone is expected to contribute directly, operate independently, and make good decisions under ambiguity. Interview Process If there appears to be a fit, we will schedule up to 3 interviews. Applications are reviewed by members of our hiring teams. Interviews may be conducted virtually or onsite.

We value speed, transparency and decisiveness throughout the process. Originally posted on Himalayas

Mit langjähriger Erfahrung und einem breiten Netzwerk bietet Med Ipersonal maßgeschneiderte Personallösungen für Krankenhäuser, Arztpraxen und Pflegeeinrichtungen.

Die professionellen Recruiter von Med Ipersonal kennen den Markt und die Bedürfnisse der Kunden und finden schnell und zuverlässig passende Kandidaten für temporäre Einsätze oder langfristige Anstellungen.
**Über uns:**
Die MediPersonal AG ist ein modernes, wachsendes Personalberatungsunternehmen, das mit innovativen Konzepten und einer zukunftsorientierten Arbeitsweise neue Impulse auf dem Schweizer Markt setzt.
Unser Standort in Zürich zeichnet sich durch ein hochmodernes Arbeitsumfeld, erstklassige digitale Tools und flache Hierarchien aus. Wir verstehen uns als strategische Partner unserer Kunden und begleiten sie mit maßgeschneiderten Lösungen in der Personalgewinnung. Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir eine/n erfahrene/n Personalberater/in & Personalvermittler/in mit Schwerpunkt Medizin.
**Ihre Aufgaben:**
· **Rekrutierung von medizinischem Fachpersonal:**
Sie übernehmen den gesamten Recruiting-Prozess von der Profildefinition über die Direktansprache bis zur erfolgreichen Vermittlung von Ärzten, Pflegefachkräften und weiteren medizinischen Fachspezialisten. Besonders, wenn Personalberater für die Medizinbranche gesucht werden, sind effiziente Prozesse entscheidend.
· **Beratung und Betreuung von Kunden:**
Durch Ihre Marktkenntnisse und Ihr Gespür für die Bedürfnisse Ihrer Auftraggeber beraten Sie Kliniken, Spitäler, Gesundheitszentren sowie Praxen professionell und erarbeiten individuelle Lösungsansätze.
· **Aufbau und Pflege eines erstklassigen Kandidatennetzwerks:**
Mit Fingerspitzengefühl nutzen Sie Ihr Netzwerk, Social-Media-Kanäle und Jobportale, um Top-Kandidatinnen und -Kandidaten für anspruchsvolle Vakanzen zu finden.

Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Recruiting, idealerweise mit Schwerpunkt Medizin oder Gesundheitswesen.

Ein gutes Gespür für die Besonderheiten des medizinischen Arbeitsmarkts, inkl. Kenntnis relevanter Berufsgruppen und Qualifikationsanforderungen.

* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, international environment.
* Proficiency with ATS platforms, LinkedIn Recruiter, and Microsoft Office applications.
Fluent German and English (written and spoken) are essential.

* Work in a dynamic, international environment.

MSC Cruises, the world's third largest cruise line, is expanding its Talent Acquisition function in support of its continued growth in the US market. Du sprichst Unternehmen aktiv an – am Telefon und über Direktkontakte – und weckst Interesse an unseren digitalen Recruiting-Lösungen.

Du hältst deine Aktivitäten im CRM nach, kennst den Stand deiner Pipeline und arbeitest auf klar messbare Ziele hin.
Mit Marketing und Geschäftsführung stimmst du dich eng ab und bringst Ideen ein, wie wir unsere Abläufe schärfen können.

Freude an Akquise: Die aktive Kundenansprache ist für dich kein notwendiges Übel, sondern der Teil, der dich reizt.
Beraterisches Denken: Du stellst die Fragen, die den Kern treffen, erkennst Zusammenhänge und erklärst deine Lösung nachvollziehbar.
Blick für beide Seiten: Du verstehst, was Personalverantwortliche umtreibt – und was Bewerber überzeugt.

Vergütung nach oben offen: Festgehalt als sichere Basis, dazu eine Provision ohne Deckelung.
Unbefristet ab dem ersten Tag: Wir planen langfristig mit dir, in einem Markt, der stabil wächst.

Arbeitsplatz auf hohem Niveau: Höhenverstellbare Tische, Herman-Miller-Stühle, Apple-Hardware – zentral gelegen in Bielefeld.
Fitness auf uns: Premium-Mitgliedschaft im Studio deiner Wahl.
Gut versorgt im Büro: Siebträgermaschine mit Julius-Meinl-Kaffee, ausgesuchte Tees, flexibles Mittagsangebot über Meyer Menü.

Ohne Anschreiben bewerben – der Lebenslauf genügt, zwei Minuten reichen.
Telefonat zum Kennenlernen – Rückmeldung von uns innerhalb von 48 Stunden.

At Fluxon , we believe that how you build matters as much as what you build. We help businesses navigate their most important technology decisions with confidence, and take responsibility for seeing them through. Founded by ex-Googlers and startup veterans, we’re proud to partner with teams behind some of the most ambitious products, including Open AI, Anthropic, Stripe, Walmart and Google.
Our work spans strategy, design, and engineering — often in complex, AI-driven environments — where clarity, speed and quality are the standard. We use AI intentionally, applying it only where it adds real value and expands what’s possible. Care shapes everything we do.
Inside Fluxon , you’ll find a global, remote-first team of experienced builders, who are curious, kind and serious about their craft. We’re building a place where people can take ownership, solve problems that matter and do work they’re proud to stand behind. If you want to do your best work alongside people who care as much as you do, you’ll feel at home here.
Many of our team members call the San Francisco Bay Area home, but this role is fully remote across Canada.

Fluxon is a culture-driven, dynamic software consulting company, and this Lead Talent Partner role is about as "choose your own adventure" as recruiting gets. You'll have real ownership over how hiring works across the Americas — with huge room to shape the role, the process, and the impact you make.
We're looking for someone who's excited to own the full recruitment lifecycle end-to-end, while staying organized, motivated, and genuinely invested in helping candidates reach their potential.

Lead full cycle recruitment across the Americas — sourcing, screening, interview coordination, and hiring for senior technical roles across teams including Product Management and Engineering
Quickly build high-trust relationships across the company and with hiring managers — including at the Director level — positioning yourself as a true partner in their hiring decisions, not just a service that fills reqs
Communicate clearly and confidently, whether you're writing candidate outreach or briefing senior stakeholders
Build recruiting plans and strategy that grow our candidate pool for current and future hiring needs
Proactively source passive candidates across major job platforms (e.g. LinkedIn, etc.)
Collaborate with the People Operations team to create the best possible candidate experience throughout the recruiting process and onboarding
Track the metrics that actually predict good hires — not just fill rate, but quality and speed of process
Take ownership of how we improve — surface friction, propose solutions, drive them to done

Have a constant drive to improve processes and iterate on how things work
Open to recruiting across functions — product, engineering, operations, and beyond
Think creatively, lead initiatives, and drive an exceptional candidate experience
Experience developing hiring processes at a fast-scaling tech company

Professional growth budget for any form of self-improvement: specialized technical training, conferences, certifications or even foreign language courses

Annual off-sites where we gather in person to build meaningful connections with your fellow Fluxon ians
Profit-sharing program for you to benefit directly from our collective growth and success
Paid sabbatical program to reset, recharge, and gain a fresh perspective

Kirby Bates Associates’ consultants are specialists focused exclusively on the healthcare executive recruitment market. With hundreds of years of combined experience and extensive professional networks, KBA provides a personalized, professional and confidential service designed to ensure that candidates are matched with the best possible opportunities.
Our inclusive search methodology is designed to create a level playing field and keep implicit bias in check so that the most qualified candidates advance.
Kirby Bates Associates is seeking an experienced Executive Recruiter to join our executive search team and help connect exceptional healthcare leaders with organizations where they can make a meaningful impact.
This is an opportunity for an accomplished recruiter who enjoys the detective work of finding outstanding talent, the relationship-building required to engage senior-level candidates, and the satisfaction of helping healthcare organizations identify their next generation of leaders.
As an Executive Recruiter at Kirby Bates Associates, you’ll be an integral member of each search team—partnering closely with our Vice Presidents and Associate Vice Presidents to develop sourcing strategies, identify and engage highly qualified candidates, assess talent, and create an exceptional candidate experience from initial outreach through placement.
If you are curious, resourceful, highly organized, and passionate about healthcare and people, we’d like to meet you.

Find Exceptional Healthcare Leaders
You’ll develop and execute thoughtful research and sourcing strategies for executive searches, using LinkedIn, professional networks, databases, associations, Boolean search techniques, and other resources to uncover outstanding candidates—including talented leaders who may not be actively looking for their next opportunity.

s.h: You’ll work closely with each search team to
s.t:
Develop targeted search and research strategies.
Identify and build pipelines of qualified executive candidates.
Use LinkedIn, ZoomInfo, professional associations, databases, directories, and other resources creatively and effectively.
Identify gaps in a sourcing strategy and recommend new approaches.
Maintain accurate, current candidate information in our applicant tracking system.
Keep the search team informed of progress, market feedback, and emerging challenges.
Turn Prospects Into Engaged Candidates
Finding great people is only the beginning. You’ll build relationships with prospective candidates, introduce them to compelling opportunities, and help determine whether there is a strong fit between the leader and our client organization.

Conduct thoughtful outreach to prospective candidates and convert qualified prospects into active candidates.
Screen candidates against established criteria and develop a clear understanding of their experience, accomplishments, credentials, and career goals.
Identify potential concerns or gaps and communicate them effectively to the search team.
Prepare candidates for interviews with Kirby Bates search leaders.
Maintain regular communication so candidates remain informed and engaged throughout the search process.
Ensure resumes and candidate materials meet Kirby Bates standards for accuracy, content, and presentation.
Help coordinate client interviews and candidate logistics.
Support ongoing follow-up with successfully placed executives during their first year.
Be a Trusted Search Partner
You’ll work collaboratively with multiple members of the Kirby Bates team and contribute insight, judgment, and information throughout the search process.
That means communicating proactively, meeting commitments, maintaining exceptional attention to detail, and ensuring that both candidates and colleagues have the information they need when they need it.
Although this is a remote position, participation in occasional in-person client meetings, internal meetings, conferences, seminars, and industry events may be required.
What Success Looks Like
Success in this role isn’t simply measured by activity. It’s about finding the right people—and engaging them effectively.

s.h: Two important measures of success are
s.t:
Speed to qualified candidates: You efficiently translate a search strategy into a strong slate of qualified prospects and candidates.
Candidate quality and engagement: The candidates you develop meet established search criteria and remain informed, interested, and engaged throughout the process.
We’re looking for an experienced recruiter who combines persistence and curiosity with excellent judgment, communication skills, and attention to detail.

s.h: Bachelor’s degree; a healthcare-related field is preferred.
s.t:
Minimum of five years of experience in retained executive search or healthcare recruitment.
Demonstrated ability to identify and engage candidates through LinkedIn and other sourcing channels.
Strong Internet research and Boolean search skills.
Experience using recruiting databases and research tools such as ZoomInfo.
Experience working with applicant tracking systems; Bullhorn experience is preferred.
Proficiency with Microsoft Word, Teams, and Excel.
Excellent writing, proofreading, and editing skills, with the ability to produce polished, client-ready work.
Excellent verbal communication and active-listening skills.
Exceptional attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.

Ability to receive feedback, adapt quickly, and continuously improve.
Self-motivation and discipline to thrive in a remote work environment.

s.h: Ability to meet applicable E-Verify requirements.
s.t:
A Master’s degree in Nursing, Human Resource Management, or another relevant discipline is a plus.
The Kind of Person Who Thrives Here
You may be a great fit if you’re someone who gets genuine satisfaction from finding the person others couldn’t find.
You’re naturally curious. You enjoy researching people, organizations, and career paths. You know that great recruiting is about more than sending messages—it requires listening carefully, asking insightful questions, building trust, exercising good judgment, and following through.
You’re comfortable working independently but enjoy being part of a highly collaborative search team. You care about the details because you understand that every candidate interaction reflects on Kirby Bates and our clients.
And you want your work to have meaning. Helping healthcare organizations find exceptional leaders gives you exactly that opportunity.

Others First — Put others before self.
We approach our clients, candidates, colleagues, and communities with a spirit of service.
Wisdom — Do the wise thing.
We exercise sound judgment, act with integrity, and strive to make thoughtful decisions.
Growth — Keep getting better.
We remain curious, welcome feedback, learn from experience, and continually improve our work.

s.t:

* eine Weiterbildung im HR, beispielsweise als HR\-Fachfrau/\-mann mit eidg. Fachausweis, oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.

* gute Kenntnisse des Schweizer Arbeitsrechts und der Sozialversicherungen.
